name: pz-ai-cut
description: Edit video in PZ AI Cut (web editor in Chrome) with Claude. Media stays on your computer.
long_description: Connects Claude Desktop to the PZ AI Cut web editor open in Google Chrome on the same computer (https://pz-ai-cut.pages.dev). Claude can transcribe speech locally in the browser, read the transcript, build edits as new sequences and add captions. Video files and projects never leave your computer – Claude only receives text.
